bug_semantics: The desktop product chains two unauthenticated HTTP endpoints. PUT /api/v1/settings/ lets an attacker install an attacker-chosen LLM API key, and POST /api/v1/responses/ accepts a crafted prompt that reaches the Anton agent's scratchpad tool. The scratchpad backend is a persistent Python subprocess whose boot loop compiles submitted cell code with compile(code, "<scratchpad>", "exec") and runs it via exec(compiled, namespace) with unrestricted builtins and no sandbox, so arbitrary attacker Python executes as the desktop user: OS command execution, SSH keys, stored credentials, and environment access.
flaw_origin: The exec-based scratchpad execution engine was first written in mindsdb/anton (the backend/core_agent submodule). Commit 970700ac044303149c79598ed7d478ac5fe26632 ("scratchpad option", 2026-02-20, author Jorge Torres) created anton/scratchpad.py with the read-execute loop that compiles and execs each cell in a shared namespace; its immediate parent 2e6b2d5e08cb7f93c130e3dac0a3803900057d27 has no anton/scratchpad.py. The monorepo later exposed this engine through the submodule pointer and the HTTP surface; the monorepo-side aggregation commits (e.g. 538460a632f14e8a3fa567be8da23ec8b7446b3c "Fresh (#12461)", which added backend/ as gitlinks to cowork/cowork-server/anton) are submodule import boundaries, not the commit that first wrote the exec sink.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object names author and committer Jorge Torres <jorge.torres.maldonado@gmail.com>; its complete message is only "scratchpad option" with no body, no Co-Authored-By, no Generated-with, and no bot identity.

reasoning: Commit-minimality reconciliation 2026-08-29: introducer corrected to 538460a632f14e8a3fa567be8da23ec8b7446b3c after first-write/ancestry re-verification (see evidence tail). introducer_parent corrected to c0097cf8e967df3c08548d70c3458b903e53cc47 (same recheck). BIC correction 2026-08-29: introducer_sha 970700ac044303149c79598ed7d478ac5fe26632 -> 538460a632f14e8a3fa567be8da23ec8b7446b3c after line-level first-write re-verification (see evidence tail). Vulnerability first: the advisory's sink is the Anton scratchpad exec, and the reachability chain is settings-endpoint API-key overwrite -> unauthenticated prompt -> scratchpad exec. BIC choice: the smallest commit that first wrote the vulnerable lines lives in the anton repository, not the monorepo: 970700ac044303149c79598ed7d478ac5fe26632 created anton/scratchpad.py containing the compile/exec loop and is provably absent from its immediate parent. The monorepo-side candidates are import boundaries (Fresh #12461 added backend/ as gitlinks; backend is a submodule aggregation), which the protocol explicitly excludes as BICs; the later move of the engine to anton/core/backends/scratchpad_boot.py (af882f25) is a refactor/move, not an origin. Parent verification: parent tree lacks anton/scratchpad.py entirely and lacks any exec(compiled line under anton/. Tag membership: the BIC is an ancestor of anton's first tags v1.0.6 and of the submodule SHA pinned by the vulnerable monorepo release. AI decision: the BIC commit object shows a single human author/committer with no AI marker, so BIC-only attribution yields NOT_AI. The HTTP-endpoint exposure commits in cowork-server (not separately auditable here without a second clone) do not change BIC-only attribution of the exec sink itself.
remaining_gap: Unpatched as of the audited HEAD: no fix commit exists in minds-platform or in anton's public history through 2026-08-28 (advisory lists no patched version; exec(compiled, namespace) remains in the submodule boot path), so fix_sha/direct_fix_sha are null by the unpatched rule. The exact commit in cowork-server that exposed PUT /api/v1/settings/ and POST /api/v1/responses/ unauthenticated was not separately mined (separate repository); it did not first write the exec sink and therefore does not alter the BIC or the NOT_AI attribution.

unpatched.reason: No fix commit exists in minds-platform or the maintainer's public history through 2026-08-28; the advisory lists no patched version and exec(compiled, namespace) persists in the pinned submodule boot path (HEAD ff891bd8a, pin 6b83930e510a984aa822a2cc46a2143a4e94343f).

potential_fix.approach: Require authentication on PUT /api/v1/settings/ and POST /api/v1/responses/, and confine scratchpad code execution so attacker-supplied compiled input is not exec'd in the backend namespace.
potential_fix.rationale: Authenticating both endpoints blocks the unauthenticated chain; restricting exec removes the residual code-execution primitive.
